purpose: Golden demo dataset (Phase 8 Step 11). Stable, deterministic scenarios used by the demo script, the demo server (scripts/demo_server.py) and the golden integration test (backend/app/tests/test_golden_demo.py).
label_method: Expected eligibility derived by hand from the published corpus rules (corpus v1.0.0). Assertions are structural (status, scheme IDs, documents, steps); reply wording is never compared. 'extraction' is the profile a correct extractor returns for the utterance — the demo mode scripts it because no LLM key is used.
note_on_income: No scheme in corpus v1.0.0 has a structured income rule, so the 'unknown information' scenario uses age (PM-KMY), which is the field the corpus actually requires.
